title: Saint Louis University Hosting Screening of Refugee Student's Film
summary_en: Saint Louis University will host a screening of a film directed by Koang Simon Thot, a senior undergraduate student and resident of Kakuma refugee camp in Kenya where he pursues his degree remotely. Thot's 15-minute fictional film short, "Destiny Can Be chosen, Fate Cannot,” will be screened on Thursday Oct. 29.
